entries.brief: Original SKAZ D&D2014 fantasy reference-book spell illustration. Mature painterly realism, restrained natural colors, strong compact silhouette readable at32px on both dark navy and cream backgrounds, generous transparent margins. Single centered motif, no text, no UI, no border, no cartoon, no noisy scene.  Wall of Ice: a solid upright curved wall of thick pale blue ice, crystalline fractures and frost, one small broken opening exhaling cold mist, quartz shard at foot. Strong simple barrier silhouette, no rainbow.
